in_hebrew.name: Fenn
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Fenn הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'φαινω' (phaino), meaning 'to show', 'to appear', or 'to bring forth'. This name was traditionally given to children who were born looking healthy and radiant, symbolizing the grace and beauty of God's creation.
